text: paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmīti . [84] sāvatthiyaṃ . tatra kho . dhammānudhammapaṭipannassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno ayamanudhammo hoti yaṃ rūpe aniccānupassī vihareyya . vedanāya . saññāya . saṅkhāresu . viññāṇe aniccānupassī vihareyya . so rūpe aniccānupassī viharanto . vedanāya . saññāya . saṅkhāresu . viññāṇe aniccānupassī viharanto rūpaṃ parijānāti . vedanaṃ . saññaṃ . saṅkhāre . viññāṇaṃ parijānāti . so rūpaṃ parijānaṃ . vedanaṃ . saññaṃ . saṅkhāre . viññāṇaṃ parijānaṃ parimuccati
